verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference documents an asynchronous Batch API, but that runs a one-off group of requests rather than a recurring schedule. The pack has no evidence of cron-style scheduling or recurring workflows in the API, console or SDKs. Scheduling is a plausible feature for an inference platform, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
